sentences.text:
Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 8083 of 2022
Applicant :- Shiv Kumar Gaur

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vikash Chandra Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.147 of 2022, under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 506 and 120-B I.P.C, Police Station Khutar, District Shahjahanpur.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is director of SSPPL.
There was contract for providing land between SSPPL and Tata Power Renewal Energy Ltd Mumbai.

entities.text: Tata Power Renewal Energy Ltd Mumbai
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The 97 acres land was provided to the informant by the applicant's company and they were ready to provide land as agreed between both the parties.

It is further submitted that the case may be related to the breach of contract between both the parties regarding which no criminal liability can be imposed on the aforesaid company in which the applicant is director.
Further submitted that when illegal demand was made by the office holder of the informant's company from the applicant and he refused thereafter this false F.I.R has been lodged against him.

Since the investigation is going on Shiv Kumar Gaur vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41629659/
1 and there is apprehension of arrest against the applicant, so request for grant of anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Shiv Kumar Gaur vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A and perusal of record, without making any comment on the merits of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case for the limited period considering the exception as considered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This anticipatory bail application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.147 of 2022, under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 506 and 120-B I.P.C, Police Station Khutar, District Shahjahanpur.
There was contract for providing land between SSPPL and Tata Power Renewal Energy Ltd Mumbai.
The 97 acres land was provided to the informant by the applicant's company and they were ready to provide land as agreed between both the parties.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is director of SSPPL.
It is further submitted that the case may be related to the breach of contract between both the parties regarding which no criminal liability can be imposed on the aforesaid company in which the applicant is director.
Further submitted that when illegal demand was made by the office holder of the informant's company from the applicant and he refused thereafter this false F.I.R has been lodged against him.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Since the investigation is going on Shiv Kumar Gaur vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41629659/
1 and there is apprehension of arrest against the applicant, so request for grant of anticipatory bail.
On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A and perusal of record, without making any comment on the merits of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case for the limited period considering the exception as considered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98.
In the event of arrest of the applicant- Shiv Kumar Gaur, shall be released on anticipatory bail till the submission of police report under Section 173 (2) Cr.P.C., on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.
25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police office as and when required;
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
